title: Al-Amanah and the Small Responsibility
summary: Responsibility builds manhood and amanah (trustworthiness). Entrust your child with a task that is theirs to complete (a plant, an animal, tidying up), and hold them accountable gently. Amanah in small things bears fruit as amanah in greater ones.
try_this: This week: Hand your child a small, consistent responsibility, and agree to follow up on it together.
reflection_prompts: What responsibility does your child take on?
